document.abstract: The SMPTE Standards Community (SC) continues the core mission of harmonization and interoperability of media technologies. Under the guidance of the Standards Committee (ST), the SC is organized into seven Technology Committees (TCs) to focus on content creation (TC 10E), applications (TC 27C), infrastructure (TC 32NF), and media management (TC 30MR, 31FS, 34CS, 35PM). This report summarizes the significant progress in the Standards Community in 2025.
